finalText:
Done. Found 12 stragglers still calling `db.query` and moved them all to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used across the rest of the codebase.

The vendored `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` was left untouched, since that's third-party code that gets overwritten on upgrade anyway. `verify.js` confirms it: no stale call sites, no accidental edits to `cache.query`, and every module still runs correctly against `db.execute`.
